title: Funeral and Burial Wishes
description: Write down your funeral, burial, or cremation preferences so your family does not have to guess during a hard time.
intro: Families often have to make many decisions within days of a death. Writing your wishes down ahead of time spares them guesswork and disagreement. Share this sheet with family, since a will may not be read until after the funeral.

sections.heading: Disposition
items: Choose burial, cremation, green burial, or body donation
Note any cemetery plot or niche you own and where the deed is
Note any prepaid funeral or burial contract and the provider
State what should happen to cremated remains
Note any organ and tissue donation wishes

sections.heading: Service
items: Choose a funeral, memorial service, celebration of life, or no service
Name a preferred funeral home
Name a preferred place for the service
List religious or cultural traditions to follow
List music, readings, or speakers you would like

sections.heading: Details
items: Choose clothing, jewelry, or items to be included
Note whether you want an open or closed casket
List people to be asked as pallbearers
Note whether you prefer flowers or donations to a charity

sections.heading: Notices
items: Write or outline your obituary
List newspapers or websites for the obituary
List people and groups who should be notified
Name the person who should share the news on social media, if anyone

sections.heading: Paying for it
items: Note funds set aside for funeral costs and where they are
List any veterans or union burial benefits you may be eligible for
Name the person you want to make final decisions
Check whether your state lets you appoint someone to control your remains
